zh: 平板搜索收起后显示为可编辑的关键词胶囊，多个关键词可分别移除。
搜索胶囊显示加载、暂停和失败状态，并保留屏幕阅读器播报。
桌面和移动端的筛选分类统一按 Agent、标签、项目、工作区排列。
en: On tablets, collapsed searches appear as editable query pills, with each search term removable individually.
Search pills show loading, paused, and failed states while preserving screen reader announcements.
Filter categories now follow the same Agent, Labels, Project, Workspace order on desktop and mobile.
